描述_EN: but the text gives no description about the shape of the zhang. an ancient chinese text entitled the zhouli (rituals of zhou) describes a 'zhang' as a ceremonial object to sacrifice to the direction south. in the first few decades of the 20th century a fairly large number of jade blades with a curved end were excavated from neolithic sites, the present example being one of them. chinese archaeologists believe this type of blades is the zhang mentioned in the zhouli.
描述_ZN: 但该文本没有给出关于张的形状的描述。 一篇名为《周礼》的中国古籍将 "张 "描述为祭祀南方的礼器。 在20世纪的前几十年里，从新石器时代的遗址中发掘出了相当多的带有弧形末端的玉刃，本例就是其中之一。 中国考古学家认为这种类型的刀片就是《周礼》中提到的张。
